storagePolicies.name: private_uploads_owner_read
storagePolicies.using:
((bucket_id = 'private-uploads'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM uploads u
  WHERE ((u.path = objects.name) AND (u.owner_id = auth.uid()) AND (u.status = 'ready'::text)))))

scope: Actual local metadata + targeted assertions; role behavior is verified separately by actual REST/Auth/Storage suites. Not a hosted audit.
